title: Under-specified: PCB spacers
prompt: I need some spacers for my PCB.

hidden_tests.description: The model evaluates without feature errors
Evaluates cleanly and every body is a valid closed solid
The largest body is spacer-sized (fits in 15 x 15 x 40 mm)
The largest spacer has a round bore for the screw

questions: Which screw size do the PCB holes take (M2, M2.5, M3)?
How tall should the spacers be, and how many do you need?
Round or hex, and do they need to be threaded (tap drill) or clearance?
clarify.assumptions: M3 hardware (most hobby PCBs), 10 mm tall, a set of four round clearance spacers: 7 mm OD, 3.4 mm bore.
